map.指示剂怎么选？: How should the indicator be chosen?
map.强酸强碱用酚酞或甲基橙均可；弱酸弱碱需按 pH 突跃范围选，否则终点误判。本工具: Phenolphthalein or methyl orange both work for strong acid against strong base; weak pairs must follow the pH jump range or the end point is misjudged. This tool only computes concentration, the indicator is an experimental choice.
map.滴定体积算浓度准吗？: Is the concentration from the titrant volume reliable?
map.体系接近完全中和且无明显副反应时可靠；弱酸弱碱需考虑离解，建议结合 pH 曲线判: It holds when the system is close to complete neutralisation with no significant side reactions; weak acids and bases need dissociation accounted for, so judge the end point together with the pH curve.
map.为什么消耗体积要读两次差值？: Why read the consumed volume as a difference?
map.滴定管初读数常非零，终点体积=末读−初读，直接读数会带入累计误差。: The burette usually starts at a non-zero reading, so the end point volume is the final reading minus the initial one; reading it directly brings in cumulative error.
